notes: Canonical memory-comparison SQL/data/parameters and batch counts; diagnostic, not a cross-core benchmark.
All timing precedes tracing. Allocation tracing disables GC for one query at a time; traced time is never reported.
Core allocation sites exclude Ruby internal objects. Answer digests compare query and execute paths on the first parameter.

results.sql: SELECT sum(score) FROM items WHERE label >= 'row5'
SELECT count(*) FROM items WHERE label = 'row500'
SELECT id, CASE WHEN label >= 'row5' THEN score + 1 ELSE score - 1 END FROM items ORDER BY id
SELECT id, score FROM items ORDER BY CASE WHEN label >= 'row5' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END DESC, id LIMIT 20
SELECT CASE WHEN label >= 'row5' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, count(*), sum(score) FROM items GROUP BY CASE WHEN label >= 'row5' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ORDER BY 1
SELECT sum(score) FROM items WHERE label LIKE 'row5%'
